description:
Execute a quote. Call haiku_get_quote first, then choose a path:
• Path A — Self-contained (WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY set): pass quoteId, sourceChainId, permit2SigningPayload + bridgeSigningPayload (if present in the quote), and approvals. Haiku signs Permit2/bridge internally, sends any approvals on-chain, and broadcasts. Returns tx hash.
• Path B — External wallet (no WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY): broadcast: false is required. First broadcast any approvals from the quote via your wallet MCP (each is a {to, data} transaction). Then call haiku_prepare_signatures if signatures are needed → sign via wallet MCP → call haiku_execute with quoteId, sourceChainId, the signatures, and broadcast: false. Returns { transaction: { to, data, value, chainId } } — broadcast transaction via your wallet MCP.
Always pass sourceChainId from the quote response.

approvals.description: approvals from haiku_get_quote. Self-contained mode only: haiku broadcasts these on-chain before the swap. In external wallet mode (broadcast: false), do not pass these — broadcast each approval {to, data} via your wallet MCP before calling haiku_execute.

bridgeSigningPayload.description: bridgeSigningPayload from haiku_get_quote (cross-chain only, for self-contained signing)

broadcast.description: If true (default), broadcasts tx. If false, returns unsigned tx.

sourceChainId.description: Chain ID of the source token (from haiku_get_quote). Recommended — if omitted, the server will attempt to recover it from the signing payloads or session cache, but passing it explicitly is safer.

userSignature.description: Pre-signed bridge intent signature (external wallet mode)

name: haiku_execute
